title: Liquid glass toolbar over scrolling DOM
blurb: A floating HTML navigation pill drawn over a live scrolling article in one WebGL 2 canvas. A fragment shader refracts the scrolling page through a rounded-rectangle lens with Snell's-law bending, chromatic dispersion, frosted blur and a pointer-lit Fresnel rim, while both the toolbar and the page behind it stay clickable and selectable.
question: Can a floating HTML navigation pill refract the live scrolling DOM behind it using Snell's-law lensing and chromatic dispersion in WebGL, while both the refracted toolbar and the scrolling page beneath it stay clickable and selectable?
result: Not verified yet in a live browser. One ElementGL canvas uploads both the scrolling article and the floating pill via texElementSubImage2D(), refracts the article texture through a rounded-rectangle SDF lens with chromatic dispersion and a 9-tap frost kernel, composites the pill DOM on top, and updates hit boxes with updateElementGeometry().
